name: Delícia de Morangos e Chantilly
description: This opera, presented by Quarteto Contratempus and Banda Sinfónica Portuguesa, tells the story of Bunny, who is in love with Benny. Their problem requires the intervention of an Augur and a Priestess to resolve.
longDescription:
The event "Delícia de Morangos e Chantilly" is an opera performance by Quarteto Contratempus and Banda Sinfónica Portuguesa. The story centers on Bunny, the main character, and her love for Benny, a secondary character. They face a problem that can only be solved with the help of an Augur and a Priestess.

The performance is scheduled for November 13, 2026, at 9:30 PM, concluding at 10:20 PM. It takes place at the Auditório Municipal de Gaia, located at R. Moçambique 183. Tickets start from €8, and the event is suitable for ages 12 and up.

This event is part of FIATO – Festival Internacional de Artes e Ópera do Porto.
